landing.desc1: CifrAS helps musicians manage, transpose, and organize their chord charts and setlists for live performances and rehearsals.
landing.demoLyrics1: I don't want to tell you my greatest love
landing.demoLyrics2: From the things I learned on the records...
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to master the stage
landing.featuresSubtitle: Features tailored for the agility of live performance and repertoire practice.
landing.desc3: Change keys in 1 click with support for sharps and flats (Bb/Eb) and precise tab transposition.
landing.desc4: Distraction-free, full-screen auto-scrolling view adjustable from 1 to 10, optimized for live stages.
landing.desc2: Organize your setlist order with drag and drop, calculate total gig duration, and add arrangement notes.
landing.featGroupsDesc: Create groups, share setlists with your bandmates, and keep everyone synced in the same key.
landing.featEditorDesc: Structured JSON chord storage and instant search by artist, title, key, or rhythm.
landing.featMobileDesc: Responsive layout tailored for tablets on music stands and phones, with generous 44px+ touch targets.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps from rehearsal to live performance.
landing.step1Desc: Save chord charts with atomic chords or build your custom repertoire in seconds.
landing.step2Desc: Customize the ideal key for your vocal range and order the setlist easily.
landing.step3Desc: Turn on full-screen auto-scroll and perform smoothly without turning pages.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to elevate your musical performances?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join musicians who have already simplified their repertoire management with CifrAS.
